scope.included: Every call reachable from public TcCtx::leq after recursive simplify, including eq_antisymm, eq_antisymm_many, is_zero, is_nonzero and their type-checker and inductive-checker consumers.
scope.excluded: Arbitrary direct calls to private leq_core with non-normal Level arguments; resource exhaustion and hardware faults.

predicate_partition: diff < 0: both original and mutant return false at the right-Zero guard
diff == 0: only the mutant guard matches

only_disputed_state.baseline_obligation: Every such state in the public recursive closure returns false in the baseline.

private_counterexamples.exclusion: Public leq simplifies Max(Zero,Zero) through combining to Zero before leq_core.
Public simplify first reduces the nested Max to Zero and then the enclosing IMax to Zero.

mutual_induction.measure: Finite acyclic Level DAG structure, with the existing IMax decomposition ordering used by leq_core.
mutual_induction.normalization_claim: Both programs produce the same simplified normal form. simplify recurses on proper children before calling is_zero; the already-simplified child satisfies the smaller zero-reflection case, so the IMax decision is identical without assuming the final theorem.
mutual_induction.zero_reflection_claim: For every normal form N returned by simplify, baseline and mutant leq_core(N, Zero, 0) return true exactly when N is syntactic Zero.
mutual_induction.recursive_equivalence_claim: Every recursive leq_core call from normalized public inputs either stays outside the changed domain or reaches a disputed state covered by zero reflection or the generated nested-IMax case.

grammar: Max(NF_nonzero, NF_nonzero), with no retained pair of two Succ heads
IMax(NF_left_nonzero_nonone, NF_right), where the retained right head is Param, Max or IMax

source_cases.argument: Zero and Param are returned unchanged.
Succ recursively simplifies its predecessor and remains Succ.
combining removes either Zero child and combines two Succ heads; every retained Max therefore has two non-Zero normal children.
IMax returns its right normal form when its left is zero or one, returns Zero when its right is Zero, combines a Succ right, and retains IMax only with a nonzero/nonone left and Param/Max/IMax right.

baseline_changed_state_cases.argument: The explicit (Param, Zero) arm returns false.
Successor peeling changes diff from zero to minus one, so the original right-Zero guard immediately returns false regardless of the predecessor.
Both retained Max children are non-Zero normal forms. The Max arm is a conjunction, and the induction hypothesis makes both comparisons false.
leq_imax_by_cases includes the positive substitution p := Succ p. subst_simp makes the IMax lhs a non-Zero normal form while rhs remains Zero, so that required conjunct is false.
The Max-tail rewrite explicitly simplifies its newly constructed Max. Each branch has a non-Zero tail, so the result returns to a non-Zero normal-form case and is false.

The only unsimplified lhs Max synthesized by the comparator is Max(IMax(a,y),IMax(x,y)). The enclosing and nested retained IMax forms make a and x nonzero/nonone and y a Param/Max/IMax normal tail, so both constructed children are non-Zero retained IMax forms; their conjunction against Zero is false.

recursive_closure.argument: Succ recursion exposes only normal subterms and adjusts diff symmetrically in unchanged code.
Retained Max splitting visits non-Zero normal children; the nested-IMax synthesized Max is covered separately.
leq_imax_by_cases calls subst_simp for both zero and positive substitutions, restoring normal form before recursion.
A Max tail is re-simplified; an IMax tail constructs the single raw Max shape proved false above.

Right-side case splits normalize both arguments. Nested right-IMax rewrites construct a Max rhs rather than literal Zero; any later Zero exposure returns through normalized substitution or successor peeling.

public_callers: TypeChecker sort and constant-level definitional equality
Inductive checker codomain, universe-ownership, constructor-level and large-elimination checks

supporting_observation.role: Consistent finite observation only; not used as the equivalence proof.
